    One drink in the cart, with the options picked in the Drink Customization dialog.
    CashierView
    Cashier screen for drinks, deals and discounts, checkout, and register settings.
    CashierView.Deal
    A deal or discount shown on the deals screen.
    Database
    All JDBC access lives here.
    Database.DailySales
    Order count and sales total for one calendar day.
    Database.Employee
    One row from the employees table.
    Database.HourlySales
    One hour of the X-report; hour is 0-23 and the payment columns split sales by how customers paid.
    Database.InventoryItem
    One ingredient or supply from the inventory table.
    Database.InventoryUsage
    One ingredient's consumption over a date range, measured in the same units as inventory.
    Database.ItemSales
    Sales totals for one menu item over a date range, used by the Sales Report.
    Database.MenuItem
    One drink from the menu_items table.
    Database.RecipeLine
    One ingredient line of a drink's recipe: how much of an inventory item one drink uses.
    Database.TopDrink
    Sales totals for one drink, used in the Top Drinks report.
    EmployeesPanel
    Manager > Employees: view staff, add or edit them, and mark them active or inactive.
    EmployeesPanel.SimpleDocumentListener
    A document listener that runs the same code for every kind of text change, so a lambda can be used.
    InventoryPanel
    Manager > Inventory: view stock, add or edit items, and restock.
    InventoryUsageChart
    Compact horizontal bar chart for ingredient consumption in the selected date range.
    Main
    Entry point.
    ManagerPage
    One screen in the manager view: a titled panel that reloads its data each time it is shown.
    ManagerTables
    Table helpers shared by the manager screens: styling, sorting, and row colors.
    ManagerView
    Manager window (wireframe pages 7-11): sidebar navigation plus one screen per button.
    MenuItemsPanel
    Manager > Menu Items: view drinks, add or edit them, and edit each drink's recipe.
    ReportsPanel
    Manager > Ordering Trends: sales by day, top drinks, low stock, sales by item, and inventory used for a date range, plus the X-report for one day.
    Theme
    Colors, fonts, and small widget helpers shared by every screen (matches the wireframe palette).
